verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms mail can be opened and scanned to view/forward/shred digitally (docs-6, docs-22, docs-26), supporting the core scan-to-digital workflow, but there is no stated turnaround time (same/next business day) and no confirmation that scans are searchable PDFs rather than images. missing for 10: explicit turnaround/SLA commitment, confirmation of searchable PDF (OCR) output, independent/hands-on corroboration of scan speed and quality.
